execution: local in-memory evaluation; no browser, remote model, or customer action
sourceBehavior: Six extracted modules plus isolated candidate fixes; results are bounded to these exact inputs.

E1.interpretation: Declared MODEL_PROPOSED and UNIMPLEMENTED relationships are excluded even with confidence 0.99. The same candidate relation is eligible only with declared OBSERVED provenance.
E1.limit: The taxonomy and filter operate on supplied metadata; this example does not prove that DOM data was really observed. The isolated candidate fix preserves restrictive supplied status and rejects known model-only type spoofing, not all false provenance.

E2.interpretation: With a synthetic governed contract, no transition is NOT_EVALUATED. Supplied complete OBSERVED_INTERACTION objects produce local PASS or FAIL; model-proposed and missing predicate data do not complete the comparison.
E2.limit: These objects were assembled in memory. No browser event, page capture, approval, or real observation happened.

E3.interpretation: Before/after target and environment mismatches stop the assertion comparison. Real identity component fields change the bound scope or expected hashes; a missing receipt hash produces NOT_EVALUATED identity.
E3.limit: Identity hashes bind supplied bytes only; they do not compare actual deployments or independently validate receipt authority.

E4.interpretation: A self-consistent producer-authored grounding receipt remains a candidate with hardEligible false. Missing receipt is invalid; unresolved source authority stays UNKNOWN.
E4.limit: The evaluator has no independent authoritative receipt readback. Synthetic APPROVED or ADMITTED strings are fixture claims, not real approval.

E5.interpretation: The pure delivery function returns raw BLOCK for six supplied satisfied gates, REVIEW for scope drift, and NOT_EVALUATED for unknown issuer or elevated disabled field. All outputs remain NOT_ACTIVATED with disabled verified-claim fields.
E5.limit: The synthetic certificates, admission receipts, dispute decision, and policy decision were all producer-authored here. Raw BLOCK is a local function return, not an actual CI block, publication, issuance, or VERIFIED_FIXED claim.
